_readme: Hand-entered numbers. Update each one when its source publishes a new figure, change as_of, then push. Values in USD trillions unless 'unit' says otherwise.

stores.label: Real estate
stores.note: Homes, commercial property and farmland. Partly financed by debt, so it overlaps the debt row. Savills publishes yearly, around September.

stores.label: Debt (all borrowing)
stores.source: IIF Global Debt Monitor (23 Sep 2026); exact total as reported by The Star
stores.note: Government, company, household and bank debt, including loans: 311% of world GDP. Traded bonds are a smaller part of it. IIF publishes about every 3 months.

stores.label: North American stocks (mostly US)
stores.note: Total value of all listed shares in the US and Canada. Ocorian gives no separate US figure.

stores.label: Other listed stocks, rest of world
stores.source: Ocorian Global Asset Monitor #5: $156.7T world total minus $75.9T North America
stores.note: Europe, Japan, the rest of Asia-Pacific and emerging markets.

stores.label: Private assets in funds
stores.source: Ocorian Global Asset Monitor #5 (19 Oct 2026): sum of four parts
stores.note: Private equity $10.46T + private real estate $1.51T + infrastructure $1.40T + private credit $1.38T. Lower than Ocorian's earlier $14.9T (end 2025) because Ocorian revised its model, not because values fell.

gold_above_ground_tonnes.note: All gold ever mined. Gold value = this amount x the live gold price.

money_hand.label: China M2
money_hand.note: Update monthly. New reports appear mid-month on the PBOC list page: https://www.pbc.gov.cn/en/3688247/3688978/3709137/index.html

money_hand.label: Japan M2
money_hand.source: Bank of Japan, Money Stock (preliminary, monthly average)
money_hand.note: Update monthly. The next release is in mid-December; its PDF follows the same link pattern (ms2611.pdf).
